outcome.technical: Retired the falsifier. drive-phase.py: removed run_falsifier, mutation_site, note_falsifiers, record_falsifiers, falsify, returned_falsifier_problems, FALSIFIER_TIMEOUT, the decide-falsifier line, the falsifier decision and its accept handler, the close stage, the submit gap line, and the helpers only they used (_copy_tree, _run_in, tree_paths, _BUILD_BROKEN, _excerpt_build_line) plus the now-unused _manifest_rules import. _filed_returns.py: removed return_falsifiers, falsifier_gaps, RETURN_FALSIFIERS and the return-shape check, so a return carrying a falsifiers field of any shape is filed and the field is not read. _manifest_rules.py: removed task_falsifiers, falsifier_problems, FALSIFIER_FIELDS, _check_falsifiers and every rules.falsifier.* warning. audit-task.py: removed scope --falsifiers (parser, VERB_FLAGS, usage text, _falsifiers_arg, the merge), tests.falsifiers from _WIDENABLE, and the 'declare that as its falsifier' fix-task note. audit-lookup.py: removed FALSIFIER_RULE and falsifier_rule from the executor brief. gen-demo-manifest.py: the schema-coverage rows say retired. Schema: tests.falsifiers and $defs/falsifier kept and accepted, descriptions say retired and read by nothing, removal a 4.0.0 item beside meta.muted. audit-executor.md (8227 bytes now, was 8756 at 571becfd per the task text; python3 tools/measure-context.py --tree plugins/audit), execute-task.md, phase-signoff.md, commands/task.md and README.md stop describing it. CHANGELOG.md Removed entry. PLUGIN-BUILD-GUIDE.md module map regenerated with python3 plugins/audit/scripts/_deps.py --write-map because drive-phase no longer imports _manifest_rules (the sweep's test__deps g1 case was red on exactly that fence). Tests: replaced the old falsifier cases in test_drive_phase.py (fv5-fv7, fp1-fp4), test__manifest_rules.py (fz1, fz2), test__filed_returns.py (fz1, fz2); added the four tests.add cases plus fp0b, fz2/fz3 style retirement pins and rf2 (no verb flag table holds falsifiers). Full sweep python3 tools/sweep-selftests.py --quiet exit 0 (337/337 files). Red proofs by stamp-verification.py red against a HEAD throwaway: all four cases proved. Compatibility: a plan carrying tests.falsifiers still validates with no finding and no rules.falsifier warning (the two faults the schema's own keywords refuse keep their one schema warning, as before). No falsifiers declared in this return: the field is read by nothing after this change, so there is no mutation the drive would run. The plan gate refused one python-heredoc write to audit-task.py ('outside the running task files ... one free file already spent on _manifest_rules.py'); every later write to it went through the Edit tool, which the gate allowed.
outcome.descriptive: The falsifier is gone from the drive, the filing verb, the validator and the executor's brief; tests.falsifiers stays accepted in the schema as a retired key so no plan stops validating.
